scope: deterministic replay of 40000 existing counters, two paired geometries each; no new random sample, server job, scientific test suite or production launch
limitations: P34/P40 already stored black and white cluster counts and their q second moments; these are not newly invented observables
the new information is E_top times absolute cluster count and its controls on the old norm4 Phase-E configurations
q/E readouts see any microscopic source only through its conditional projection onto 1,q,q^2; a nonzero response does not escape three-state readout closure
source residual variance is not a field count or a continuum operator assignment
an inconclusive finite pilot is completed work, not a prohibition on the source
uncertainty: estimated aligned-delete-one covariance; nominal Gaussian summaries, not exact confidence certificates; full matrix is redundant and is not inverted
